mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_saving_allocation (monthly_saving_plan_id, product_subscription_id, allocated_amount, allocation_order) VALUES (#{monthlySavingPlanId}, #{productSubscriptionId}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{allocationOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT monthly_saving_allocation_id, monthly_saving_plan_id, product_subscription_id, allocated_amount, allocation_order FROM monthly_saving_allocation WHERE monthly_saving_plan_id = #{monthlySavingPlanId} ORDER BY allocation_order ASC
